_doc: Real-data carousel from story AFR-STORY-000005 (West Africa TikTok lead research, ANONYMIZE_ONLY — no business is named). Every slide is an OBSERVATION from the tracker or clearly-framed ANALYSIS. No deliverable is promised in the CTA.

slides.headline: 44 of 45 businesses had no website
slides.sub: What we found researching West African businesses that sell on TikTok.

slides.headline: The storefront is a caption
slides.body: Real estate, agencies, shops — selling through TikTok captions and hand-typed WhatsApp replies.
slides.source: AfriShield lead research · Aug 2026 · 45 businesses · CM, NG, CI, SN, GN

slides.headline: It works until the buyer asks AI
slides.body: An AI assistant answers from pages it can read and trust. A caption buried in a feed isn't one of them.

slides.headline: Two or three numbers in one caption
slides.body: A pattern we saw again and again. Every unrouted number is a call that can ring out.

slides.headline: A one-page site is step zero of AI visibility
Save this for your one-page site
slides.body: Share it with someone who sells on TikTok.
